messages:
tara: Quick sync thread — prepping a short "acceptance + signal" playbook for DP cohorts. Need a version that fits the roadmap slide and an ops checklist.

omar: Can we keep it to two pages: 1) recruitment & scoring, 2) launch gates + signals + eviction rehab. Exec likes compact.

ryan: From eng: add a required "smoke run" step: partner triggers an automated smoke test that runs the main workflow in staging (logs uploaded). Makes activation visible.

sara: Good call. My draft gates: Recruit (scorecard + SOW), Integrate (smoke run + end-to-end demo), Observe (2-week stability window on dev traffic), Feedback (1 structured eval/sprint), Ops (runbook + alert hooks).

lex: Legal note: single-line data handling clause for invite + explicit KMS note for private DPs. Also propose an export checklist: data pull request window (30d), contact, format.

ops-bot: Template pointers: /ops/templates/dp-scorecard.csv, /ops/templates/dp-smoke.yml, /ops/templates/dp-eviction-notice.md. Automation can send notices after thresholds.

omar: For scoring: impact, integration complexity, compliance risk, velocity. Each 1-5. Invite threshold = total >=11 and compliance risk <=3.

ryan: Engineering add-on: optional feature flag per partner to enable prefix-caching and quantization suggestions. Helps us measure cost/latency impact during trial.

sara: Include incentives: credits + 4 prioritized bug-hours per quarter + optional early-access to optimize settings. Frame incentives as trade for structured feedback.

lex: Eviction policy suggestion: trigger if Observe gate fails (stability < target) OR no structured feedback for 3 consecutive sprints. Notice = 7 days, archive = 30 days, rehab path = 2 consecutive good sprints.

omar: Also add a 7-day grace after any platform update before counting signal failures. Avoid evicting for transient regressions.

ryan: Ops/metrics ask: need owners for these metrics: sessions = product-telemetry team, api_calls = infra, smoke-run status = ci-team, structured-evals = research. Ops, can you scaffold a starter dashboard?

ops-bot: I will create a dashboard stub once owners are tagged in ticket. See /ops/templates/dp-dashboard-stub.md. Deployment window Thu 18:00 UTC.

sara: I'll assemble the one-slide playbook + a 1-page ops checklist. Owners: sara (slide + playbook), omar (scorecard), ryan (smoke-run + FF), lex (legal blurb), ops (dash + automation). Target: circulate by Fri COB.

tara: Two small asks before sign-off: 1) include a short partner comms template about what we expect from feedback, 2) a short FAQ about data retention and KMS keys for private installs.

lex: I'll draft both. Keep language plain and collaborative.

sara: Thanks. If nobody objects I'll post the draft doc in /product/dp-playbook-onepager.md and tag owners. Please review there. :thumbsup:
